scope: Reassess cadmpeg-codec-sat as an optional independent reader for extracted ACIS payloads, reconcile its immutable release artifact and support claims, and refine the existing composed evidence gate.

method.kind: Read-only research against official project release metadata, published crate documentation, project support ladder, neutral B-rep contract, and architecture documentation.
method.evidenceBoundary: Published documentation establishes a candidate route, declared profile, artifact metadata, and explicit limitations only. No release binary/crate archive was inspected or executed; no local payload was tested; this review does not qualify any ACIS, DWG, DXF, AcDs, kernel, or native-application support profile.

observed: GitHub's v0.6.1 release page identifies commit 9e8f6d6 and lists prebuilt artifacts for Apple Silicon macOS, x64 Windows, and x64/ARM64 Linux.
The Apple Silicon macOS archive is published with SHA-256 932a5067d76617707366c7a913e92e2c48484ccacd4f1ceecb065bbeb97dad4b.

docs.rs identifies cadmpeg-codec-sat 0.6.1 as published 2026-10-12 and documents exact release crate dependencies; archive-to-tag source equivalence and dependency resolution were not independently verified in this review.

The reader handles bare SAT/SMT and SAB/ASM payloads, including the documented Spatial ACIS binary 217/218 branch. Other ACIS bands may be framed with a substituted grammar but are reported as Admission::Unverified with a dialect loss.
The codec transfers supported records to a neutral B-rep IR but does not parse DWG/DXF containers, AcDs pages/indexes, or entity/history ownership, and does not write SAT/SAB.

The project's aggregate support ladder reports L1 for the declared ASM/ACIS stream family even though the documentation describes connected B-rep transfer for supported records. The L3 model claim requires evidence across the declared profile; one passing payload cannot promote that score.

The IR documents incidence/orientation and geometric carriers as distinct and defines body-to-point topology. This supports a structured cross-parser comparison, but does not amount to a separately qualified geometry kernel or native CAD acceptance.
evidence.planUse: At the existing composed external checkpoint only, if the exact release artifact is already authorized and available, compare a byte-identical locally extracted 217/218 payload and preserve the complete DecodeReport, losses, body/topology/carrier inventory, units, scale, and identity. Reject unverified dialect substitution, blocking or shape-relevant unknown losses, or incomplete body disposition as a semantic pass. Keep geometric-kernel validity, native consumer acceptance, and DWG/AcDs ownership as separate evidence stages.

planDelta.existingGateRefined: Tighten the optional cadmpeg-codec-sat comparison to an immutable release/artifact/source/dependency identity and exact verified 217/218 input profile; characterize its output as independent parser/model-transfer evidence, not general semantic qualification.
nextActions: Continue local implementation with focused generated tests; the optional reader is not a blocker or per-slice dependency.

If the composed external gate is reached and the exact binary/crate is already available, first bind it to release v0.6.1 / commit 9e8f6d6, record artifact and dependency hashes, and verify the crate/source relationship.
Feed only byte-identical extracted payloads in the verified 217/218 profile; retain full decode/loss reports and compare topology/carrier details with independent analytic expectations.
Keep the reader result separate from libdxfrw's DWG/AcDs extraction/ownership proof and from any qualified kernel or named native application result.
Keep J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting pending their own platform and independent semantic evidence.
